lead.headline: The first win is in; three byes sit in your lineup
lead.deck: 195.3 to 132.76 with 0.6 left on the bench. Jefferson, Gordon and the Vikings' defence are off this week, Coker is questionable, and Kamara is losing his backfield.
lead.body: Start with the bad news. Three of your starters are on bye and set to score nothing: Justin Jefferson, Ollie Gordon and the Vikings' defence. Jalen Coker, the man for Jefferson's slot, is questionable with a quad; Dave Canales says he is on track but has big practice days ahead. Alvin Kamara had five touches last week while Kendre Miller took ten carries, and Kyle Monangai has had no word since Saturday on his toe. Last week was the good news: 195.3 to 132.76, the first win, with Josh Allen adding 30.5 on Monday night and only 0.6 left on the bench. This week: start Coker and Terry McLaurin, and put in a claim for the Ravens' defence before 01:00 Wednesday.

doFirst.headline: Three byes to fill and one claim before 01:00 Wednesday
doFirst.deck: Coker and McLaurin in for Jefferson and Gordon; the Ravens for the Vikings.
doFirst.note: Set Coker for Jefferson and McLaurin for Gordon now. Claim the Ravens' defence, dropping the Vikings', with the Chiefs as a second claim. If Coker is inactive at 09:30 Sunday, McLaurin moves to WR and Kamara takes the flex.
